notes: Building and Engineering News, vol. 28 part 2 (Internet Archive buildingengineer28128cont), the weekly issues from 7 July to 29 December 1928. Same method as the earlier volumes: every numbered entry under Building Permit Applications and Building Contracts was taken from the djvu.xml OCR, East Bay headings set aside, and each San Francisco lot built from the block corner on the DPW street centrelines and compared with the sf-parcels shapes; a placement was accepted where the lot starts within two feet of a lot line of today (or the record names an unambiguous corner) and the roll dates the building 1927-1930, and alterations were matched by printed street number in sf-eas-addresses where the roll dates the building before 1928. Every published row was read against the page image, location first; 153 of the 200 rows read needed a name, a cost or the wording corrected, and a cost or name that could not be read on the image was left out. Where a permit and its contract appear in the same issue the page carries one entry and the contract finding is held; an entry printed twice in one issue is published once. Descriptions of rows marked confidence low were built from the OCR and have not been read against the image. Owners are private individuals and are cut everywhere (raw.note); a firm or institution named as owner is kept, and where the contractor or architect named is the owner (same surname at the owner's address) that name is cut too. Sub-trade contracts (steel, heating, plumbing, electric work, tile, painting, floors) are timeline entries and set no builder credit. Completion notices, liens, sub-contracts printed 'on above' and the news columns were not taken. Issue dates come from the running heads (redate.py), checked to be weekly and unbroken.

coverage.remaining: Vols. 26, 27 and 28 read (January 1926 to December 1928); the other 28 half-year volumes (1915 to January 1932) are unread, vol. 29 part 1 (January-June 1929, buildingengineer2929cont) next. In this volume: 284 rows placed on a parcel whose roll year fits, all single houses with no architect named and no page, are logged and held until another fact gives the parcel a page (extra.placed_apn; they still need the image check). 337 rows have a nearest parcel that was not accepted (the lot starts off today's lot lines, or the roll dates the building outside the window). 514 rows were not placed: 242 location lines not parsed (tract lots, garbled headings), 161 street pairs that do not cross under the names read (OCR spellings, renamed streets), 110 printed street numbers with no EAS row today and 1 ambiguous.
coverage.note: 2,133 numbered entries read, 1,335 San Francisco rows, 821 placed on a parcel, 200 picked and read against the page image, 186 published on 171 pages (94 seeded), 12 held back at the image check (same-issue contracts merged into the permit entry, repeat listings, two uses that contradict the roll) and 2 on parcels with no EAS address.
